title: The Odyssey
tone: Drawn as a Greek black-figure vase painter would: bold silhouettes in profile, the sea as a running wave scroll, ships long and low with eyes on their prows.

episodes.title: Setting sail from Troy
episodes.scene: A long ship with its oars out leaves a burning city behind.
episodes.keyImage: The ship sailing right across the sea line; behind it, small on the left, the walls of Troy with three tongues of flame.

episodes.title: The Cyclops
episodes.scene: In a cave the one-eyed giant is blinded with a stake; the men escape clinging under his rams.
episodes.keyImage: The arch of a cave mouth; a ram walking out right, a man clinging beneath its belly; the giant's head and groping hand in the dark behind.

episodes.title: The bag of winds
episodes.scene: The crew open the bag; the winds burst out and drive the ship back.
episodes.keyImage: The ship tilted, sail bellied backwards; spiral wind curls pouring from an open sack on deck.

episodes.title: Circe
episodes.scene: The enchantress turns the crew into swine at her palace among the trees.
episodes.keyImage: A woman in a long robe raising a cup; two pigs at her feet facing away; columns and a tree behind.

episodes.title: The Sirens
episodes.scene: Odysseus is tied to the mast; bird-women sing from the rocks; the crew row on, ears stopped.
episodes.keyImage: The ship sailing right, a man bound upright to the mast; on two rocks ahead, birds with women's heads, one swooping over the sail.

episodes.title: Scylla and Charybdis
episodes.scene: A many-headed monster reaches from a cliff while a whirlpool turns on the other side.
episodes.keyImage: A cliff on the left with long serpent necks reaching down toward the ship; on the right a spiral whirlpool in the sea line.

episodes.title: Calypso's island
episodes.scene: Years pass on a quiet island; he builds a raft beneath the trees.
episodes.keyImage: A small island rising from the sea line; one tree; a lone figure sitting, facing the sea; a crescent moon.

episodes.title: Shipwreck
episodes.scene: Poseidon's storm breaks the raft; dolphins and waves everywhere.
episodes.keyImage: Tall curling waves filling the scene; a broken raft tipped on a crest; two dolphins leaping.

episodes.title: Home to Ithaca
episodes.scene: He lands under an olive tree; his old dog knows him; Penelope at her loom.
episodes.keyImage: An olive tree on land; a man in a cloak leaning on a staff; an old dog lifting its head at his feet.

episodes.title: The bow
episodes.scene: He strings the great bow and shoots through the line of axe heads.
episodes.keyImage: An archer kneeling, bow drawn, facing right; a row of twelve axe heads; the arrow's line passing through them all.
